card.name: The word gravitational in physics text
card.fires_on: The word "gravitational" (or its ending, as in Gravit|ational) in astronomy and physics passages, often before pull, interaction, force or instability.

modes.label: Full word
modes.description: The whole word "gravitational" used as an adjective before a noun like pull or interaction.
modes.example: Like any other form of matter gas molecules feel the<< gravitational>> pull of the planet they surround, so

modes.label: Split word
modes.description: The ending of "gravitational" or "gravitation" after "Gravit" or "grav", including in keyword lists.
modes.example: Nebula; Hydrogen Gas; Whirlpool Galaxy; Extreme Environment; Boiling Temperature; Air Pressure; Celcius; Oxygen; Gravit<<ational>> Force; Jupiter; Kilometers; Inner
